3. Cast Angel of Invention ({3}{W}{W} — two Plains, three Swamps). Choose Fabricate 2 to create two 1/1 Servo tokens. Angel of Invention's static ability gives all my other creatures +1/+1: Vampire Cutthroat, Indulgent Aristocrat, and Sacred Cat are now 2/2, and each Servo is 2/2. (All 10 mana has been used.)
4. Declare attackers. Angel of Invention (2/1), Vampire Cutthroat (2/2), and Indulgent Aristocrat (2/2) attack Gideon of the Trials (6 total damage against 5 loyalty). Sacred Cat (2/2) and the two Servos (2/2 each) attack the opponent (6 total damage against 3 life). Ayli stays back — her damage is prevented this turn anyway by Gideon's +1 ability. The opponent has no creatures left to block with.
5. Combat damage is dealt simultaneously: Gideon of the Trials drops to −1 loyalty and the opponent drops to −3 life. State-based actions are then checked (rule 704.3): Gideon (0 loyalty) is put into the graveyard (704.5i), but the opponent does not lose during this check because they still controlled a Gideon planeswalker when the check occurred, so the emblem's "you can't lose the game" applies. The check is then repeated: the opponent now has 0 or less life (704.5a) and no longer controls a Gideon planeswalker, so the emblem no longer applies — the opponent loses the game and I win.
